dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature forming a smooth falcate spline from the posterior base to the sub-apical region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point displays a rounded shape classification with a medium pixel radius, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a convex contour with an approximate 50-degree incline relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the visible maximum base width to the maximum vertical height is approximately 1.8:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct triangular notch is visible on the lower third of the trailing edge; irregular micro-serrations are present along the upper margin of the trailing edge near the apex; multiple light-colored linear cutaneous scratches are visible on the lateral surface of the fin and body.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive light-gray mottling and depigmented patches are distributed across the lower half of the dorsal fin and the adjacent dorsal flank.
